messages:
Sarah: Heads-up — code freeze for v1.12.0 in ~4h (18:00 UTC). If you need a late merge, post PR + short justification. :warning:
Alex: PR #5187 — minor runtime tweak for embeddings quant. No schema change. Requesting late-merge exception. Tests green locally. @Prateek can you sanity-check? :pray:
Maria: Please add a changelog bullet before we consider exceptions. Release notes owner will block otherwise. Quick template works: '- fix: embeddings quant runtime path (#5187) — CHANGELOG.md'
Prateek: Policy recap — late merges allowed only for critical bugfixes or fixes that reduce regressions. Need smoke + perf sanity + security signoff. Share smoke logs and steps.
Alex: Smoke ran on staging, all green. Buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/rw/5187 — summary: all checks passed. Smoke command I used:
```
./tools/run_smoke.sh --branch release/v1.12.0 --pr 5187
```
Buildkite Bot: buildkite/status: build 5187 — passed — 7m 24s :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: Reminder — deploy freeze starts 18:00 UTC. Any late merges must be scheduled within rollback window (19:00-20:00 UTC) and require an oncall engineer.
Jim: I can cover rollback window and run a full perf smoke at 17:30 UTC. Ping me when you're ready.
Prateek: Sounds good. @Alex add the changelog entry, a short backward-compat note, and rebase onto release/v1.12.0. If Jim's perf looks clean we'll rubber-stamp.
Alex: Done — changelog added and rebased at 17:16 UTC. Pushed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5187 :thumbsup:
Maria: If you need to cherry-pick the commit into the release branch, use:
```
git checkout release/v1.12.0
git pull origin release/v1.12.0
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
git push origin release/v1.12.0
```
Sarah: Thanks everyone. If anything flares in the next hour we'll hold the exception and move it to the next patch. Otherwise we'll merge pre-freeze. :eyes:
